event.active_generic_land_05_strange_gia: You catch the master ribbon. The hat turns, but drags you along with it.
You shove spectators out of the path before the giant brim sweeps them away.
A support strut snaps. The hat sags sideways and keeps rolling like a crab.
A gust tears a three-meter ceremonial hat from a dignitary. The headpiece rolls on its brim through the parade, crushing decorations and racing toward a crowded street.
You slide under the brim and undo the strap keeping the frame rigid.
The post wedges into the frame. The hat stops dead in a cloud of feathers.
You let the hat finish its run. The stalls at the far end pay the price.
The hat bounces off a fountain, changes direction, and rolls back toward the procession. Its wooden frame still holds, with several ribbons dragging across the ground.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_spr: Cross on the rhythm
You miss a bounce and land shoulder-first on a fixed stone tile.
The street kicks you sideways into a bollard hard enough to leave a bruise.
You ride the spring rhythm and reach the jammed tile without falling.
You turn the bounces into a perfect sequence and land directly on the faulty mechanism.
Read the triggers
You misread two plates; a spring clips your chin and scatters your notes.
You identify the wrong cycle and the crowd starts moving before you can stop it.
You find the sequence that keeps one strip of tiles still.
You spot the master plate controlling the others and create a stable passage.
Wait for the emergency stop
You stay off the pavement. The inventor eventually pulls a red handle, but one tile remains jammed.
The Spring-Loaded Pavement
An inventor unveils spring-loaded pavement meant to “speed up citizens.” Three tiles fire in sequence, launching pedestrians over stalls and cutting off the only stable strip of ground.
Pin the spring
You pin the loaded spring and the tile finally stops bouncing.
Mark the tile
You draw a broad circle around the trap. Pedestrians start avoiding it immediately.
Kick the cover back
The cover drops back into place, but the mechanism keeps grinding under your feet.
The Tile That Won’t Stop
The main lever shuts almost everything down. One tile keeps bouncing, its open cover exposing a compressed spring threatening to jump free of its housing.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_rol: Catch the axle
The axle lifts you off the ground and throws you into an already-broken barrier.
You slow one wheel for a moment, but the house tears free and keeps rolling.
You wrench the axle sideways and slow the house enough to keep pace.
You bend its path just before the crossroads and save an entire row of stalls.
Jump through the window
You miss the frame, bounce off a shutter, and tumble under a rain of roof tiles.
You enter sideways and topple a cabinet that slides across the room with you.
You clear the window and reach the interior before the next turn.
You slip through the window, catch a beam, and land beside the main brake assembly.
Sacrifice a timber beam
You jam a heavy beam into one wheel. It splinters, but the house slows violently.
Clear the crossroads
You run ahead of the house and clear the crossroads. The building keeps rolling downhill.
The Runaway House
A local contest moves whole houses on enormous wheels. One loses its pulling team, rolls downhill alone, and carries balcony, furniture, and chimney toward a crowded crossroads.
Pull the awning
You pull the awning toward the wall and keep the balcony from scooping up pedestrians.
Swing inside
The railing snaps under your weight and you hit the cobbles hard.
You miss the inner doorway and remain hanging from the balcony until the next impact.
You use the railing like a pendulum and swing into the central room.
You swing onto the landing and catch the brake rope in the same motion.
Throw out the furniture
You lighten the house by throwing soft furniture onto the road. Its speed drops only slightly.
The Swinging Balcony
The house hits a bollard. Its balcony tears loose on one side and now sweeps the street like a giant arm while a red rope hangs through the open door.
Haul the brake
The rope snaps and lashes your face before vanishing under the floorboards.
The brake bites for one second then slips, barely enough to miss the main wall.
The brake finally grips the wheels and the house stops in a long screech.
You lock all four wheels before the final turn and save the entire building.
Steer into the hay
You free a steering wheel and send the house into a stack of hay bales.
Jump before the wall
You abandon the building before the final impact. The facade pays for the rest of the ride.
The Brake Under the Floor
Under an overturned table, the red rope leads to a giant cart brake linked to all four wheels. The wall at the end of the street is closing fast, and the mechanism is already groaning.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_off: You break the sacred stillness and block the front wheel. Several sleepers open one eye.
You drag the sleeper out of the path without waking the whole street.
You stay frozen like everyone else. The cart plows through baskets and ends against a bollard.
A bell rings and the whole street immediately lies down for the civic nap. One poorly chocked cart keeps rolling toward a sleeper who is obeying the custom with admirable seriousness.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_bac: Enter the race
You trip over a pennant and drag two racers into a stack of crates.
You backpedal too fast and hit a racer who shoves you toward the wrong turn.
You match the pack’s rhythm and position yourself between the racers and the crowd.
You backpedal flawlessly and instantly become the pace everyone else copies.
Read the mirrors
A reversed reflection fools you and sends the pack toward the judges’ table.
You call the turn too late and several racers bunch against the rope.
You decode the mirrors and call the real turn before the collision.
You spot a planted reflection and keep the pack out of a fake shortcut.
Move the barrier
You open a safety lane. The racers pass, but the judge waves you onto the course.
The Backward Race
A local race requires running backward while looking only into mirrors held by volunteers. One mirror falls, the pack now aims at the crowd, and the judge refuses to stop the event.
Run with the mirror
You slip and the mirror shatters under your feet as the pack arrives.
The mirror shakes enough to send half the group into hay bales.
You keep the reflection steady and guide the pack through the corner.
You run sideways with the mirror raised and turn the corner into a perfect display.
Paint an arrow on the ground
You paint a huge arrow that the racers can see in their mirrors.
Close the wrong turn
You close the wrong route with the crowd rope. The pack has only one option left.
The Mirror Corner
At the next corner, three mirrors face each other and show three different turns. The racers are backing toward them without being allowed to look over their shoulders.
Move the finish line
You drag the finish rope into a clear area. The judges protest, then count it anyway.
Backpedal to the finish
You catch the finish rope with your heel and end up under the banner.
You cross sideways and knock over the bucket of medals.
You cross cleanly and the crowd cheers the maneuver.
You finish first without turning around once, to the crowd’s roar.
Step off the track
You leave the race before the line. At least nobody finishes in the crowd.
A Moving Finish Line
The last mirror shows the finish line, but a vendor has set up directly in front of it. The judges still refuse to stop the race and are already waving the final flag.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_noo: Brace the tower
The noodle mass folds you over and pins you against the judges’ table.
You slow the fall, but half the tower still slides into the street.
You hold the structure upright long enough to clear the judges.
You reset the central mast in one heave and save almost the whole tower.
Cut the tiers apart
Your cut frees a whole sheet of noodles that wraps your legs and drops you.
You separate one tier too late; the sauce is already cascading.
You detach the dangerous tiers before they pull down the whole structure.
You turn the collapse into clean portions that servers catch in midair.
Let the cook slice it
The cook spots the weak point and slices the tower tier by tier, but cannot save the sauce.
Save the bowls
You pull the bowls off the table edge. The tower collapses behind you.
The Noodle Tower
A contest stacks noodles around a mast until the tower stands taller than a floor. The mast suddenly bends, the judges remain underneath, and a vat of sauce tips with the whole structure.
Dam it with tables
You lay several tables across the street. The sauce stops before the main steps.
Kick a channel
The slick ground drops you straight into the hot sauce.
Your channel redirects only part of the wave; the rest coats the stones.
You open a path to a gutter and the wave changes course.
You divert the entire sauce wave into the drains without hitting the crowd.
Get to dry ground
You leave the organizers chasing their sauce while you reach the steps.
The Sauce Wave
The vat flips completely. A wave of hot sauce runs down the street, pushing plates ahead of it and heading toward steps packed with spectators.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_dan: Follow the bridge steps
You take the wrong rhythm and slam into the railing as the deck pivots.
You clear two sections before a sudden movement throws you back to the center.
You read the sway and reach the control box between two movements.
You use every tilt like a dance step and reach the controls without losing balance.
Decode the mechanism
You pull the wrong lever and the bridge speeds up for several seconds.
You slow one half, but the other keeps moving out of rhythm.
You identify the main cam and stop the sequence before the next tilt.
You reset the gears to a slow motion that lets everyone cross.
Have the shipwright read the gears
The shipwright recognizes a capstan-like transmission and points out the jammed counterweight.
Stay on the center platform
You wait on the fixed center platform. The bridge keeps dancing around you.
The Dancing Bridge
A mechanical bridge crosses the river by swaying to a municipal drumbeat. The drum tears mid-crossing; the bridge keeps moving on its own, speeds up, and traps several people between moving sections.
Release the counterweight
You free the counterweight. The bridge drops hard but settles flat.
Hold the chain
The chain slips and burns your palms before slamming into the pulley.
You slow the weight but cannot stop it completely.
You hold the chain long enough for the mechanism to lock.
You lock the chain on the perfect link and stop the bridge without impact.
Clear the bridge
You use a lull to get everyone off before the next jolt.
The Wild Counterweight
Inside the housing, a counterweight rises and falls far too fast. Its chain skips a tooth with every motion, and the next cycle may release it entirely.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_goo: You recover the first ribbons before the geese trample them. The vote can still be reconstructed.
You follow the flock leader. It carries the deciding ribbon into a side lane.
You distract several geese with the judges’ grain. The remaining ribbons head the other way.
Here, trained geese choose the festival winner by pecking colored ribbons. One steals the whole basket, and the feathered jury charges into the street carrying every vote.
The lead goose hits your knee and the rest trample over your belongings.
You close one alley too late and several ribbons vanish under a cart.
You turn the flock back toward the square and recover almost the whole basket.
You turn the leader around and every other goose follows it back to the judges.
The leader drops the ribbon for a shiny buckle of little value.
You let the improvised jury decide by itself. The organizers will have to own the result.
The geese reach a narrow street. The leader still holds the deciding ribbon in its beak while the others tear down decorations and attract a small procession of spectators.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_bar: Catch the barrel
The barrel hits your chest and rebounds faster toward the musicians.
You deflect the barrel without stopping it; it only changes rows.
You absorb the bounce and slow the barrel enough to follow it.
You send the barrel into an empty angle and the crowd applauds the improvised rhythm.
Predict the bounces
You call the wrong bounce and a stall takes the barrel through its sign.
You keep it off the crowd, but the barrel smashes several tuned instruments.
You spot the pattern and guide the musicians out of its path.
You read three bounces ahead and clear a completely empty path.
Open the side gate
You open a service gate. The barrel bounces through it and continues into the yard.
The Barrel Orchestra
A local orchestra plays tuned barrels like drums. The deepest one, swollen by heat, suddenly jumps from its stand and bounces between the rows with a cannon-like boom.
Open the bung
You pull the bung. Pressure escapes in one endless note and the barrel finally stops.
Ride the barrel
The barrel changes bounce and throws you into the front-row chairs.
You hold on for two bounces before slipping, but the barrel has lost some speed.
Your weight breaks the rhythm and the barrel finally rolls instead of bouncing.
You ride the final bounce and set the barrel upright in front of the musicians.
Let it split open
You step back. The barrel eventually splits and sprays the yard with sawdust.
The Bouncing Bass
In the yard, the barrel bounces lower each time, but its bung whistles at every impact. One final pressure spike could still split it open.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_bel: Grab the horns
The goat lifts you with a headbutt and the bell rope wraps around your ankle.
You slow the goat, but it charges again and drags you several meters.
You hold its head long enough to loosen the rope around its neck.
You turn with the charge and guide the goat into an empty area.
Lure it with food
The goat prefers your bag, bites it, and scatters your belongings across the square.
It follows for two steps, then bolts again when the bell knocks against its side.
The food distracts the goat long enough to pull the rope into a safe line.
The goat follows you calmly into an empty corner despite the stuck bell.
Cut the rope
You cut the rope. The goat leaves with the bell but stops dragging people behind it.
The Goat and the Bell
A huge festival goat chews the ceremonial bell like a snack. The bell jams between its teeth; the animal panics, charges away, and drags a long flag-covered rope behind it.
Vault the rope
The rope catches you mid-jump and slams you onto the ground.
You clear it, but a pennant catches you and spins you around.
You clear the rope and finally reach the knot behind the goat.
You vault the rope, catch the knot in midair, and free the bell.
Strip the pennants
You tear off the pennants snagging benches and baskets. The rope slides much more freely.
Give the goat space
You clear a lane. The goat eventually slows on its own at the far end of the square.
The Rope Sweeps the Square
The goat circles the fountain. Its taut rope now sweeps the square at knee height, snagging benches and threatening to trip anyone still standing.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_rot: Jump between sections
You jump at the wrong moment and the moving edge crushes your leg against a bollard.
You reach the other section, but the rotation throws you into a shuttered storefront.
You cross from one section to the next and reach the mechanism hatch.
You use the rotation as momentum and land directly on the maintenance hatch.
Track the bad gear
You follow the wrong vibration and jam another section of the street.
You find the hatch, but the failing gear has already lost several teeth.
You follow the noise to the gear skipping a tooth on every rotation.
You also spot the emergency lever before the street completes another rotation.
Get everyone off
You get pedestrians off the moving sections. The street still rotates, but with nobody aboard.
The Rotating Street
An urban square rotates its streets on a huge platform to “vary everyone’s routes.” The mechanism skips a tooth; two sections turn in opposite directions and trap pedestrians between their edges.
Wedge the gear
The wedge shoots out of the teeth and hits you before the gear starts again.
You slow the gear, but two teeth break and the rotation continues in jerks.
You lock the gear and the street sections finally stop closing together.
You lock the gear at dead center without breaking another tooth.
Pull the red lever
The emergency brake drops. The whole square stops with the sound of breaking dishes.
Close the hatch
You close the hatch and leave the municipal mechanics to recover their invention.
The Teeth Under the Street
Under the hatch, a gear the size of a table jumps in its housing. Every skipped tooth pulls the two street sections one notch closer together.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_umb: You cut the master line. The umbrellas scatter, but stop dragging the whole group together.
You tie the bundle to a heavy cart. It slides several meters before holding.
You pull the lightest carriers back down before they leave the street.
For a public spectacle, dozens of giant umbrellas share one rope. A gust fills them all at once; the bundle lifts their carriers and drifts toward the rooftops.
A roof tile breaks under your foot and drops you into a bent gutter.
You reach the roof, but the knot keeps sliding toward the next chimney.
You reach the knot and release the umbrellas one by one.
You release the bundle at the perfect moment and every carrier lands on an awning.
You secure the bundle around a solid chimney. The umbrellas still snap in the wind, but stay put.
You keep your distance. The fabric eventually tears and the ropes fall back into the street.
The master rope catches around a chimney. The umbrellas thrash above the roof like one huge sail while several carriers still hang just below the gutter.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_fak: You scrape the newest outlines and uncover a handle hidden under the pattern.
You follow the smoke to the wall where the real exit should be.
You make an immediate exit through the window. The owner is already presenting the bill.
The local custom is to paint dozens of fake doors on building fronts. Today, someone also painted over a real exit, and kitchen smoke is building up behind the decorated wall.
You tear paint away from the handle and finally open the real door.
The panel holds and your shoulder takes the full impact.
You crack the panel without opening it wide enough for a proper exit.
The panel gives way and opens a passage wide enough to escape.
You pop the door cleanly off its hinges and set it down without hurting anyone.
You paint a huge cross on the real door. Nobody will mistake it today.
Under the layers of paint, half a handle appears. Heat has swollen the door shut, and smoke is now beginning to creep under the threshold.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_sou: Turn the soup cannon
The cannon swings too fast, knocks you down, and launches a pot into an awning.
You shift the barrel, but the next shot still clips the edge of the tables.
You turn the barrel toward an empty area before the next shot.
You swing the cannon without spilling the vat and save the entire table row.
Read the pressure gauge
You turn the wrong valve and the needle jumps back into the red.
You lower the pressure slightly, not enough to prevent another shot.
You identify the valve feeding the piston and slow the cycle.
You understand the whole circuit and isolate the pressure chamber.
Let the cook purge it
The cook spots the steam feed and cuts the heat, but the chamber remains pressurized.
Flip the tables
You flip the tables into shields. Bowls strike them while the pressure keeps rising.
The Soup Cannon
A festival serves soup by launching bowls from a steam cannon. The mechanism runs away: it reloads itself, the gauge enters the red, and every shot fires a little lower toward the crowd.
Close the valve
The scorching handle slips and steam blasts your arm.
You turn the valve a quarter before the heat forces you to let go.
You close most of the steam feed and the piston slows sharply.
You shut the steam off in one motion and keep the chamber under control.
Cool the pipe
Your cooling is too sudden and cracks a joint, releasing a steam jet.
The pipe cools down, but the chamber stays hot enough for another shot.
You drop the temperature and buy several seconds before the next cycle.
You cool the exact joint that matters and stop the pressure rise.
Open the relief valve
You open the relief valve. A cloud of steam covers the stage, but the cannon slows.
The Red Valve
Behind the cannon, a large red valve shakes on its spindle. Steam hisses around the joint while the piston is already preparing another bowl salvo.
Catch the bowls
Two bowls collide in front of you and hot soup splashes across your arms.
You catch one, but the others smash against the overturned tables.
You catch the last bowls one by one as the cannon dies down.
You catch the whole salvo and set the bowls upright in front of the spectators.
Drop the safety shutter
You drop the service shutter. The last bowls shatter against it without reaching the crowd.
Let the last shot go
You take cover. The last bowl punches through the festival banner and lands in a fountain.
The Final Salvo
Pressure finally drops, but four bowls are already loaded. The piston cycles one last time and launches them together toward the row of overturned tables.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_bub: Pop the bubble chain
A bubble bursts around you and throws you into a clothesline.
You pop several, but one large bubble still carries off a whole basket.
You burst the low bubbles before they lift any more baskets.
You trigger a chain of pops that clears almost the whole street.
Read the air currents
You choose the wrong draft and a basket drifts straight toward a pointed roof.
You save some clothes, but the largest bubble rises too quickly.
You spot a downdraft and guide the baskets toward a low courtyard.
You use two opposing drafts to bring almost every bubble back to street level.
Drain the vat
You tip the vat into a gutter. New bubbles stop forming, but the old ones keep rising.
The Giant Bubble Laundry
A street laundry uses a vat that makes bubbles large enough to carry baskets. Too much soap falls in, and clothes, baskets, and stools begin rising above the rooftops.
Reach the bubble
You slip on soapy tiles and land hard on an awning.
You brush the bubble with your fingertips but fail to grab the basket.
You catch the basket handle and pull it against the roof before the bubble bursts.
You recover the basket and pop the bubble over a safe awning.
Throw a sheet
The sheet sticks to the bubble and slows it enough to pull it against the roof.
Wait for it to pop
You wait. The bubble bursts farther away and the basket drops onto a pile of laundry.
The Bubble Over the Roof
The largest bubble catches against a chimney. A heavy basket hangs beneath it, and the soap film warps with every gust, ready to burst above the street.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_arg: You turn one statue toward the wall. Its orders stop colliding with the other one’s.
You note the contradictory sequence and identify which phrase triggers the other statue’s reply.
You impose one direction on the pedestrians. The statues keep arguing behind you.

Two mechanical statues in a historic square normally announce the hour. Today one orders everyone left and the other orders right; each reply triggers the next, and the crowd keeps circling between them.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_one: You form a human rail. Your friend catches your arm without putting the other foot down.
You plant both feet and catch your friend before the fall. The judges whistle immediately.
You hop beside your friend and guide the line to the end. The judges award you a small prize.
During the one-leg festival, your childhood friend wobbles at the front of a tight line. Nobody is supposed to put both feet down before the bell, and the whole group starts falling like dominoes.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_clo: A step retracts under your foot and you hit two levels lower.
You gain a few steps before a sudden shift sends you back down.
You exploit the cycle and reach the upper landing before the next bell.
You cross the whole sequence without hesitation and open a path for everyone else.
You miss one count and point out the exact step that disappears next.
Your calculation works for one cycle, then the bell speeds up again.
You find a repeating pattern and move several people across at the right moment.
You spot the timing wheel and lock the mechanism into its slowest sequence.
You bypass the spectacle on the service ladder. The stairs keep changing behind you.
A public staircase changes shape at every chime to “wake up the legs.” Its bell malfunctions and speeds up; steps retract into the wall while several pedestrians are still using them.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_tor: Grab the harness
The tortoise drags you across the stones before the strap slips from your hands.
You turn the animal slightly, but it keeps shoving the other taxis ahead.
You pull hard enough to break the formation and open a lane between the shells.
You turn the lead tortoise and the entire convoy follows its new direction.
Calm the convoy
Your shout sounds like the start signal and every tortoise accelerates together.
One tortoise slows, but the others push it from behind.
You find a steady tone and the first tortoises stop crowding each other.
The convoy stops almost in unison, as if rehearsing a routine.
Let the helmsman signal
The helmsman uses maneuvering signals; the drivers understand and open a lane.
Clear the sidewalks
You move pedestrians onto the steps. The convoy keeps bunching in the center.
The Tortoise Taxis
Giant tortoises serve as taxis and usually move in a perfect line. An unfamiliar bell makes them all speed up; their shells jam side by side and the convoy pushes toward a blocked crossroads.
Separate the shells
Two shells clamp your arm and throw you when they separate.
You gain a few centimeters, not enough to free the middle tortoise.
You separate the two shells and the middle tortoise can finally turn.
You clear the center in one heave and the whole convoy reforms into a line.
Unbuckle a saddle
You remove a saddle jammed between two shells. The extra space is enough to separate them.
Wait for them to back up
You keep the area clear. The tortoises eventually back out one by one without help.
The Jammed Shells
At the crossroads, three tortoises jam shell-to-shell. The middle one keeps pushing while the other two slide slowly toward steps crowded with pedestrians.
event.active_generic_land_05_strange_ech: You throw a tarp over the horn. The next echo becomes a muffled rumble instead of an impact.
You shout one very short word. The machine repeats it without enough energy to shake the windows.
You leave the square in silence. Behind you, the machine keeps repeating the official’s last words.

A municipal megaphone automatically repeats every announcement for latecomers. Its system is now feeding back into itself: each repetition grows louder, windows shake, and the official keeps shouting more orders into it.
